announcements.title: This version is outdated: PhDRacket 0.1.1 Beta is available
announcements.body: PhDRacket 0.1.0-beta.1 is outdated. Version 0.1.1 Beta brings menus, a command palette, split editors, Find in Files, themes, multi-page Settings with auto save and keyboard shortcuts, and fixes. To update, click Update 0.1.1 in the status bar, or open About and choose Check for updates.
